title: The directedness of the Rudin-Keisler order at measurable cardinals
summary: The manuscript is concerned with the Rudin-Keisler order of ultrafilters on measurable cardinals. The main theorem proved read as follows: Given regular cardinals $λ\leq κ$, the following theories are equiconsistent modulo ZFC: (1) $κ$ is a measurable cardinal with $o(κ)=λ^+$ (resp. $o(κ)=κ$). (2) The Rudin-Keisler order restricted to the set of $κ$-complete (non-principal) ultrafilters on $κ$ is $λ^+$-directed (resp. $κ^+$-directed).
